data.name: tweak.show_extensions.description
data.value: Always show extensions such as .txt or .exe in file names.

data.name: tweak.show_hidden.description
data.value: Show files and folders marked as hidden.

data.name: tweak.show_protected_os_files.description
data.value: Show operating system files that Explorer normally hides. Deleting them can break Windows.

data.name: tweak.open_this_pc.description
data.value: New Explorer windows open on This PC instead of Home / Quick access.

data.name: tweak.full_path_title.title
data.value: Show full path in the title bar

data.name: tweak.full_path_title.description
data.value: Show the folder's full path in the Explorer title bar.

data.name: tweak.compact_mode.description
data.value: Reduce the space between items in Explorer lists.

data.name: tweak.item_checkboxes.description
data.value: Show a check box on each item to select several files with the mouse.

data.name: tweak.hide_recent_files.title
data.value: Hide recent files in Quick access

data.name: tweak.hide_recent_files.description
data.value: Stop listing recently used files on Home / Quick access.

data.name: tweak.hide_frequent_folders.title
data.value: Hide frequent folders in Quick access

data.name: tweak.hide_frequent_folders.description
data.value: Stop listing frequently used folders on Home / Quick access.

data.name: tweak.classic_context_menu.description
data.value: Show the full Windows 10-style context menu directly, without "Show more options".

data.name: tweak.taskbar_left.description
data.value: Put the Start button and app icons on the left, like Windows 10.

data.name: tweak.hide_task_view.description
data.value: Remove the Task View button from the taskbar.

data.name: tweak.hide_search.description
data.value: Remove the search box or icon from the taskbar. Turning it off shows the search icon.

data.name: tweak.start_recommendations.description
data.value: Turn off recommendations for tips, shortcuts and new apps in Start.

data.name: tweak.start_more_pins.description
data.value: Use the Start layout that shows more pinned apps and fewer recommendations.

data.name: tweak.start_hide_recent_apps.description
data.value: Don't list newly installed apps in Start.

data.name: tweak.start_show_all_pins.description
data.value: Expand the pinned section of Start so every pin is visible.

data.name: tweak.no_app_launch_tracking.description
data.value: Stop Windows from tracking app launches to improve Start and search results (this also empties "Most used").

data.name: tweak.no_recent_documents.description
data.value: Hide recommended files in Start, recent files in Explorer and recent items in Jump Lists.
